text:
maria (infra): heads-up, eu-west1 rack3 showing intermittent fan/RPM noise across 3 cards, latency spike on hosted inference routes :rotating_light:
ashok (sre): seeing it in the collectors too — metric blips around 13:02 UTC, cross-checking with pci errors
ken (runtime): any Xid or ECC logs? could be a flaky card tripping ECC and stalling the NVML driver
jess (eng-oncall): we got a small uptick in 95th pct tail at the API gateway, correlated with a3c inference pool node ids: gnode-eu3-{12,13,15}
maria (infra): logs show repeated PMIC power-sense toggles and fan rpm bounce on gnode-eu3-12. nvml shows transient power limits toggling from 250W -> 150W -> 250W
ashok (sre): exact dmesg snippet: `NVRM: Xid (PCIe) 79@0` followed by `nvidia: GPU 1 power limit changed by pmic`
ken (runtime): that 79 is the TDR/Xid indicating possible thermal/power event. Recommend draining gnode-eu3-12, taint, move pods. I'll prepare a canary
jess (eng-oncall): agree — planning a quick drain. tagging @oncall and leaving one replica behind for graceful handoff
sre-bot: incident created INC-2026-2345: eu-west1 rack3 GPU power/thermal anomaly (auto-detect).
maria (infra): queueing drain now: `kubectl drain gnode-eu3-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m`
ken (runtime): while draining, can someone run these checks on the node: `nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,POWER,FAN` and `journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced --no-pager --since "10 minutes ago"`
ashok (sre): ran them — output attached (pasted):
```
GPU 0: temp 87C (spiked to 98C), fan 0 RPM -> 0 RPM -> 6500 RPM, power draw 240W
GPU 1: temp 70C, fan stable 5200 RPM, power draw 200W
GPU 2: temp 45C, fan stable 4200 RPM
```
maria (infra): weird that fan 0 dropped to 0 briefly. PMIC reports multiple resets. Could be bios/power-rail glitch or cabling, not purely thermal.
ken (runtime): impact to inference: KV cache eviction and increased generation latency when that GPU was in MPS mode. We saw request retries to fallback models for a minute.
jess (eng-oncall): redirecting traffic off the affected pool now — changed route policy to prefer eu-west1-rack5, applied feature flag `routing.fallback=on` :thumbsup:
ashok (sre): observed one GPU Xid 79 escalate into `GPU reset required` and the kernel attempts a reset but fails 1/3 times -> potential hardware replace
maria (infra): marking node for replacement. I'll open an RMA ticket with vendor but want to collect stable evidence. Please capture the `nv-hostengine` dump and `i2c` reads
ken (runtime): grabbing the dumps now and uploading to /mnt/ops-shared/eu-west1/rack3/1845001234. Also enabling persistent logging for 24h on that node.
ashok (sre): note for runbook: if fan RPM goes to 0 and PMIC toggles within <10s, treat as hardware PMIC fault, schedule immediate swap (hot-swap in our rack).
jess (eng-oncall): are we confident this was causing the API impact and not a separate network blip? We saw no packet loss on the node but the node's kernel showed `nv_peer_memory` resets
maria (infra): cross-correlation: timeline aligns with GPU PMIC toggles and model-serving pod restarts due to `nvidia-driver` disconnects. Network remains green.
ken (runtime): follow-up: add a quick guard in runtime to circuit-break MPS on nodes that report PMIC reset >2 times in 5m. That would avoid tail-latency cascades. Filing PR for runtime: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/987
maria (infra): RMA opened: RMA-78622, vendor ETA 3 business days. Replacing gnode-eu3-12 with spare gnode-eu3-s12. Scheduling maintenance window tonight 02:00 UTC for physical swap.
ashok (sre): temporary mitigation: blackhole GPU 0 at kernel level to keep node in service for non-accelerated jobs? risky. Prefer replace.
jess (eng-oncall): for postmortem, capture: detection signal, routing fallback timing, customer impact (requests retried or slow), and cost of rerouted inference. I'll start a doc. :memo:
sre-bot: INC-2026-2345 Severity updated to P2 (no widespread errors, isolated to rack3).
maria (infra): thanks all. After drain, node returned to Ready with gnode-eu3-12 tainted. Holding until swap. Will post final status once vendor confirms. :white_check_mark:
ken (runtime): small note: add metric for PMIC-reset-count per GPU to infra dashboard, threshold alert at 2 resets/10m. I'll add to grafana team board.
jess (eng-oncall): good triage. If anyone sees reoccurrence on gnode-eu3-13 or -15, escalate to P1.
ashok (sre): keeping an eye. ping me if RMA goes into longer lead time.
maria (infra): closing thread for now — will update when replacement done.
